mappings.gap: Account subtype must select the correct versioned domain; no BIAN API implemented.
required_evidence: Versioned domain and service operation review

mappings.gap: One-side record changes do not establish atomic journals.
Internal movement is not necessarily a payment; currency, party roles and message identity are missing.
Restricted CBI specifications were not retrieved; no CBI or SEPA message generator.
US CTR threshold and overloaded SAR signals are not an Italian suspicion assessment.
required_evidence: Current UIF format and acknowledgement evidence

mappings.gap: US daily directional aggregation lacks Italian month, currency and executor attribution policy.
Code-to-model lineage is present; runtime persistence and complete event lineage are absent.
required_evidence: Durable event-to-report lineage and access evidence

mappings.target_concept: Operational resilience and ICT change governance
mappings.gap: Static evidence checks do not establish recovery, incident management or third-party controls.
